content.value: Assume that INTθ and INT1 are connected to two switches named S1 and S2. Write a program in which, whenever S1 goes low, the content of Port C increases by one, and when S2 goes low, the content of Port C decreases by one. Whenever the value of Port C is bigger than 100, PD7 is high; otherwise it is low.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2022
